profile.headline: GitHub, Co-founder CoderSpace (she/her), WSET 3 Certified, Certified Professional in Web Accessibility (CPWA)
profile.summary: Arelia is a software engineer on GitHub’s Education team, which provides benefits to teachers, students and schools. She is co-founder and director of education and technology at CoderSpace, a nonprofit where high school students on Chicago’s South Side learn web development. Arelia is also a former co-organizer of PromptConf, an inclusive conference on the joy of computing; a former co-organizer of BlackByte, an organization for Black women in technology; and a former chapter leader of Girl Develop It Chicago, which provides opportunities for non-binary individuals and women interested in learning web and software development. Arelia is an honoree of Crain’s Tech 50 and Chicago Inno’s 50 on Fire. She has a lifelong passion for the web and a drive to make tech more diverse and inclusive.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Engineer on the client-side platform team which guides front-end best practices and improves developer experience for feature teams.
- Work spans ESLint, Vitest, CI/CD, scripting, and debugging, while applying security best practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Engineer on the Global Campus Rails application
- Advocated for and lead engineering improvements to build a more accessible application (https://github.blog/2023-05-05-building-a-more-inclusive-github-global-campus/)
- Engineering lead on various projects resulting in more refined scope, reduced costs, and more maintainable code

positions.description: - Engineer on the Global Campus Rails application

positions.title: Developer Program Manager, Teachers
positions.description:
- Manage GitHub Campus Advisors teacher super fan community and other teacher communications and programs, such as training courses for teachers learning how to teach with GitHub
- Event coordination and logistics, including building event landing pages in Rails
- Partner with product teams for communications and education around teacher-facing products, such as GitHub Classroom and the GitHub Teacher Toolbox

positions.description:
- Chapter Co-Leader for the Girl Develop It Chicago Chapter, with more than 5,000 members

positions.description: PromptConf is a single-track, polyglot tech conference in Chicago. Forked with 💜 from !!con. PromptConf is a non-profit corporation and certified 501c3.

positions.title: Co-founder, Director of Education and Technology
positions.description:
- Teaching front-end web design and development to high school students annually in July and August and on Saturdays throughout the year; initially under the umbrella of the University of Chicago Community Programs Accelerator
 - Developing curriculum for current and future programs
 - Train former students to work as teaching assistants and instructors
 - Connect program with broader tech community

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implement features in React, PHP and Backbone; unit testing with Jest and Enzyme
 - Write technical design documentation
 - Collaborate with platform engineers on API
 - First to implement CSS Grid in production

positions.title: Web Developer II
positions.description:
- Led front-end practices for RESTful Ruby projects and related 3rd party projects by maintaining a custom style library and creating pattern documentation
- Built components using Sass and React
- Worked closely with visual designer and maintained and documented design system
- Set standards for code quality via semantic HTML and BEM methodology, visual regression testing, advocating for accessibility and encouraging clean code and reusable components
- Mentored junior developers and promoted learning and collaboration beyond my team through lunch and learns and developer-designer discussion sessions

positions.title: Digital Producer, Front-end Developer (Contract)
positions.description:
- Managed initial digital build of UnitedAirtime.com
 - Worked on team of developers and contributed code to initial build, maintained content and made updates, and made revisions for second iteration of site

positions.title: Time Off
positions.description:
- Planning and preparation for July 2015 CoderSpace cohort
 - Worked on personal and freelance projects
 - Further developed coding skills, particularly in JavaScript, Sass and Python

positions.title: Digital Producer, CMS Developer (Contract)
positions.description:
- Managed digital build and content production for Kellogg’s Open for Breakfast website
 - Served as CMS front-end developer; worked with design team on content, cropped and compressed assets in Photoshop, and laid out content using CMS tool, HTML and CSS; created a scalable structure for organizing assets in the Adobe CQ CMS tool; drafted style guide for consistent markup
 - Handled troubleshooting problems; wrote HTML and CSS for site-wide fixes and provided to larger development team

positions.title: Digital Producer (Contract)
positions.description:
- Project manager for the 2014 McDonald's Monopoly Online Game; ensured website was built to specifications
 - Drafted technical specifications and other project documentation
 - Led discussions with external development team and internal teams
- Post-launch analytics and monitoring

positions.title: Digital Product Manager, Oprah.com (Contract)
positions.description:
- Developed requirements documentation and wireframes for various sections and features of Oprah.com redesign including Quotables, site search and several admin tools
- Designed UI for internal and end users; partnered with design and development teams
- Wrote HTML and CSS for editorial and sales content; collaborated with editorial and sales teams to launch sponsored campaigns

positions.title: Jr. Project Manager (Contract)
positions.description:
- Served as product owner on Scrum/Kanban hybrid team; translated business requirements into design/development solutions; performed user acceptance testing
- Facilitated communication among various groups and vendors that are part of a closed-loop e-commerce marketing process, including paid search, SEO, call center and business analysis teams; constant interaction with design and development teams for e-commerce landing pages
- Reviewed new designs and developed products for appropriate visual hierarchy, ease of use and to identify improvements that could increase ROI for company and clients; managed multi-variant testing

positions.title: Assistant Producer/Project Manager
positions.description:
- Produced interactive products including new and redesigned sites, e-commerce, mobile and database and application development; executed rapid-development and long-term projects; oversaw QA
- Introduced Agile methodologies to the company for a software project
- Determined and managed scope, schedule and cost; communicated internally and externally
- Consulted, determined projects and design and development decisions, and provided training for clients
- Created conceptual sketches and wireframes; designed user experience for end users and administrators
- Managed resources including teams of developers and designers; coordinated resource schedules with other managers; oversaw SEO, analytics and social media campaigns alongside internal teams
- Performed and managed troubleshooting, revisions and maintenance; liaison between client and other departments such as billing, hosting, domain name services, etc.

positions.title: Communications Assistant, Tourism Division
positions.description:
- Reviewed and revised content for newly launched websites including Arkansas.com, ArkIndustryInsider.com and mini-sites; updates via CMS using WYSIWIG, HTML and CSS
 - Edited and proofread English- and Spanish-language division materials
 - Social media interaction and monitoring; promotion of tourism news and activities
 - Managed revisions for 2012 Arkansas Adventure Guide including updating information for 800 sites

positions.title: Executive MBA Program Coordinator
positions.description:
- Managed events, budgets and vendors for Executive MBA recruiting, including networking series that routinely drew close to 100 guests, and for outside organizations such as the St. Louis Business Journal and Financial Executives International 
 - Established and managed social media presence for Executive Programs
 - Developed and edited communications materials for recruiting, sales and branding
 - Proofing and design input for redeveloped department website; updates via MS SharePoint
 - Assisted executives from application through graduation and as alumni; identified best practices with CRM
 - Supervised temporary staff for extended periods; hiring, assignments, payroll and appraisal responsibilities

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
- Developed outreach to key audiences for nonprofit Arts and Treasures of Latin America
- Recommended specific improvements in operational effectiveness and provided project management tools

positions.title: Freelance Writer
positions.description:
- Conducted interviews with individuals and businesses throughout community
- Wrote reviews, profiles, and features

projects.title: Mountain Harbor Resort Redesign
projects.description:
Mountain Harbor Resort launched a redesigned website that better communicates the resort’s luxurious offerings, opportunities for adventure and family-friendly atmosphere.

Site features and updates include a CMS tool, which the client did not previously have; main page and interior graphic callouts for booking, fishing, Turtle Cove Spa, etc.; a guest review form; and updated panorama and video technology using TourWrist and YouTube embeds.
